titulo: Quoted charset values are not detected by `get_encoding_from_headers`
texto: Quoted charset values are not detected by `get_encoding_from_headers`. `requests.utils.get_encoding_from_headers` fails to detect charset values when they are surrounded by single or double quotes in the Content-Type header. In such cases, the function returns `None` instead of the correct encoding string. Unquoted charset values continue to behave correctly.  ## Expected Result  When a quoted charset is present in the `Content-Type` header, the function should return the unquoted charset value.

texto: `prepare_body` stream detection regression. <!-- Summary. --> Requests 2.34.0 changed the stream detection in PreparedRequest.prepare_body() from `hasattr(data, "__iter__")` to `isinstance(data, Iterable)`.
